plan.note: Two 1-bit CCITT scans, 18471 x 14400 px each, declared 400 ppi. Pixel coordinates below are image pixels from `pdfimages -png`: sheet-000 = EXT6P02 fuselage, sheet-001 = EXT6P01 wing.

manual.note: Page 47 two-view is vector; coordinates are PDF points from `pdftocairo -svg` (y down). Page 43 throws/CG, page 32 spinner-to-firewall.

method: Manual picks read from 1:1 to 1:8 crops with a printed pixel grid; uncertainty_px is the reading half-range, not the accuracy of the paper plan. Automatic measurements (ruler, wing edges, airfoil, bottom-view widths) are recomputed by measure.py.

wing_sheet.scale_source: printed 36 in ruler along the bottom of sheet-001 (auto)

centerline_x.what: vertical line labelled with the centreline symbol, left wing panel (bottom view)

rib_2D_x.what: target of the '2D' leader at the fuselage-side root rib

cg_marker_y.what: centre of the 'CG Range' balance symbol drawn at the root

tip_x.what: outer edge of the tip block, left panel

aileron_inner_x.what: inboard end of aileron at AR4

aileron_outer_x.what: outboard end of aileron next to the tip block

le_anchor.what: approximate heavy leading-edge line; only selects runs for the automatic fit

te_anchor.what: approximate heavy trailing-edge line; only selects runs for the automatic fit

hinge_offset_anchor_px.what: approximate aileron hinge line distance ahead of the TE; selects runs for the automatic fit

te_flat_inboard_y.what: straight TE inside the fuselage, x < 3225

stab_full_size.sheet: sheet-001 (stab/elevator drawn at full size beside the wing)

elevator_root_corner.what: inboard TE corner of the upper elevator

elevator_inner_hinge.what: inboard end of the diagonal relief cut, near the hinge

fuselage_side.sheet: sheet-000, FUSELAGE SIDE VIEW (reduced scale; calibrated in measure.py from the root rib chord)

rudder_hinge_x.what: between fin post and rudder LE strips

balance_bottom_y.what: lower edge of the rudder air balance

top_profile.what: upper outline; under the canopy this is the canopy sill (the canopy is a separate shell)

bottom_profile.what: lower outline (cowl chin, belly, tail cone)

root_airfoil_outline.what: outer edge of the double outline line of the root rib drawn at 0 deg in the side view, read from single-column run scans (upper = run start, lower = run end)

fuselage_bottom.sheet: sheet-000, FUSELAGE BOTTOM VIEW (same reduced scale as the side view)

x_offset_to_side_px.what: side x = bottom x + offset; spinner tip 950 vs 985, tail post 15790 vs 15820

cowl_half_width.what: cowl outline y 10675..12475, front face to cowl joint

fuselage_width_at_wing_pt.what: wing root lines on both sides, top view
